name: InitCardVerify

parameters.help_en: A custom business unique identifier that you define for subsequent troubleshooting. The value is a combination of letters and digits up to 32 characters in length. Make sure the value is unique
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。
支持长度为32位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The MetaInfo environment parameter. Obtain this value by using the client SDK
parameters.help_zh: MetaInfo环境参数，需要通过客户端SDK获取
parameters.name: meta_info

parameters.help_en:
The document type. Valid values:
- IDENTITY_CARD: resident identity card
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型
- 居民二代身份证：IDENTITY_CARD
parameters.name: card_type

parameters.help_en:
The verification mode. Valid values:
- OCR_VERIFY: OCR recognition and authentication mode
parameters.help_zh:
核验方式，取值：
- OCR_VERIFY：OCR识别且认证模式
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en:
The verification type. Valid values:
- ID_2_META: two-factor identity verification (name + ID card number)
parameters.help_zh:
核验类型，取值：
- 身份二要素（姓名+身份证号）：ID_2_META
parameters.name: verify_meta

parameters.help_en:
The number of card pages to be collected by the SDK. Valid values:
- 1: collects the front side only.
- 2: collects both the front and back sides.

- If the verification type is ID card validity period (VerifyMeta is set to ID_PERIOD), set this parameter to 2
parameters.help_zh:
SDK采集卡证页数
- 可以输入1和2， 输入1采集正面，输入2采集正面+反面。

- 如果核验类型是身份证有效期（VerifyMeta取值ID_PERIOD），必须输入2
parameters.name: card_page_number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to temporarily store images collected by the app. Valid values:
- Y: Yes.
- N: No.
- If you set this parameter to Y, the query operation returns card image information
parameters.help_zh:
是否临时存储app采集图片信息。
- Y：是
- N：否
- 如果此处选择是，在查询接口支持返回卡证图片信息
parameters.name: picture_save

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL for authentication results. The URL must start with https. After the authentication is complete, the system sends a callback to this URL with the certifyId and passed fields automatically appended. Example: https://www.aliyun.com?certifyId=xxxx&passed=T

> **Warning** The callback is triggered only when the authentication is complete. No notification is sent if the authentication is abandoned, interrupted, or not performed. After you receive the callback notification, call the query operation to obtain the authentication details if needed
parameters.help_zh:
- 认证结果的回调通知地址，必须以https开头。
- 平台在完成认证后会回调该地址，并自动添加certifyId、passed字段，示例：https://www.aliyun.com?certifyId=xxxx&passed=T
- 警告
仅当认证完成时才会触发回调，若认证中放弃、异常中断或未进行认证均不会通知。建议您收到回调通知时，若有需要可通过查询接口获取认证详情资料信息
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en: The security token used for anti-replay and anti-tampering verification. If you specify this parameter, the CallbackToken field is included in the callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 安全Token，用于防重复、防篡改校验。如果传入该参数会在回调地址显示CallbackToken字段
parameters.name: callback_token

parameters.help_en:
The photo capture mode (manual or automatic). Valid values:
- shoot: manual capture
- scan: scan mode 
- auto: automatic switchover
parameters.help_zh:
拍照方式枚举(手动/ 自动拍照)
- 拍照 shoot
- 扫描 scan 
- 自动切换 auto
parameters.name: doc_scan_mode
